systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Acoustic Shockwave Hydrodynamic Defatting & Emulsion Destabilization Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Sanitary Acoustic Cavitation Liquid Defatting Unit (3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 & 61-01 / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic / OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.95)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous Acoustic Shockwave Chamber with Dual Opposed 20–45 kHz PZT Transducer Horns, Hydrodynamic Venturi Constriction Orifice, and Triple-Stage Inert Hydrocyclone Phase Separator
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L Stainless Steel Flow Cell (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm) with Grade 5 Titanium Acoustic Horns and Kalrez 6230 Sanitary O-Rings
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Acoustic Attenuation Enclosure (<80 dBA at 1 m), Dynamic Overpressure Rupture Discs (45 bar), Hydrodynamic Cavitation Anti-Choke Transducers, and Automated CIP Clean-in-Place Spray Cycles
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous acoustic cavitation and hydrodynamic shockwave defatting skid. Demulsifies native milkfat globule membranes (MFGM) at 18–35°C without thermal stress, achieving 96.8% cream separation efficiency, producing ultra-pure skim dairy streams (<0.04% residual fat) and preserving bioactive sphingolipids and polar phospholipids.

systemArchitectures.name: Continuous Cheese Whey Centrifuge Sludge & Buttermilk Demulsifier
systemArchitectures.classification: Dairy Byproduct Valorization Acoustic Separator (3-A Sanitary 60-01 / USDA-FSIS Dairy Certified / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Frequency Megasonic & Acoustic Shockwave In-Line Chamber with Hydrodynamic Shear Slit
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L Food-Contact Core with Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) Erosion-Resistant Horn Coating
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Flow-Loss Automated Cavitation Interlock, In-Line Acoustic Emission Sensors, and Bursting Disc Safety Relieving
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered specifically for cheese whey, clarified butter serum, and industrial sweet buttermilk. Releases bound polar membrane lipids from casein matrices at ambient temperature, producing premium cosmetic-grade polar phospholipids and clear de-lipidated whey protein isolate (WPI).

systemArchitectures.name: Continuous Plant-Based Dairy Alternative Defatting & Clarification Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Vegan Beverage Refining Unit (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / EHEDG Hygienic Class I / 3-A Sanitary Standards)
systemArchitectures.technology: Acoustic Shockwave Sonotrode Array coupled with Multi-Stage Micro-Orifice Constriction Chamber
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L Chamber with Ti-6Al-4V Medical Grade Acoustic Coupling Horns
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Differential Pressure Transmitters, Continuous Soundproof Acoustic Baffle Panels, and Automatic Water-Flush Shutdown
systemArchitectures.description: Optimized for defatting and clarity stabilization of oat milk, almond extract, soy milk, and coconut water emulsions without thermal coagulation or astringent off-flavors.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular ASH-DD Research & Dairy Rheology Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Sanitary Pilot Acoustic Shockwave Validation Unit (ATEX Zone 22 / CE Mark / 3-A Sanitary Standards 61-01)
systemArchitectures.technology: Variable Orifice Geometry (0.4 to 1.8 mm) Flow Cell with High-Speed Laser Vibrometer & Pressure Pulsation Sensors
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Hastelloy C-276 Cavitation Core with Optical Borosilicate Viewing Windows and Monocrystalline PZT Piezo-Actuators
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Emergency Hydraulic Depressurization Loop, Digital Acoustic Frequency Tracking, and Double Containment Seals
systemArchitectures.description: High-precision analytical development and process scale-up skid for dairy technology research centers studying milkfat globule membrane rupture kinetics, cavitation bubble collapse micro-jets, and lipid droplet size distributions.

feedMatrices.name: Fresh Whole Bovine Raw Milk (3.85% Fat, 3.25% Protein, pH 6.72, 18–22°C)
feedMatrices.description: Standard bovine dairy matrix stabilized by a 10–20 nm trilayer milkfat globule membrane (MFGM). Acoustic shockwaves impart intense transient micro-jets (v > 1,100 m/s) that shear the outer glycoprotein corona, coalescing free triacylglycerols for clean mechanical hydrocyclone skimming.

feedMatrices.name: Industrial Sweet Cream Buttermilk (1.80% Fat, 3.40% Protein, pH 6.65, 20–25°C)
feedMatrices.description: Byproduct of commercial butter churning containing rich concentrations of fragmented MFGM membranes. Acoustic shockwave destabilization aggregates lingering neutral lipids while preserving high-value sphingomyelin and phosphatidylcholine polar headgroups in solution.

feedMatrices.name: Clarified Cheddar Cheese Whey Sludge (0.45% Residual Fat, 0.85% Protein, pH 6.20, 22–26°C)
feedMatrices.description: Residual whey stream destined for whey protein isolate (WPI) microfiltration. Residual fat fouling causes rapid membrane flux decay; ASH-DD reduces residual lipids below 0.03%, increasing ultrafiltration membrane lifespan by 4.2x without chemical flocculants.

feedMatrices.name: Acid Yogurt Whey Byproduct Stream (0.35% Fat, 0.65% Protein, pH 4.45, 18–24°C)
feedMatrices.description: High-acid dairy effluent from strained Greek yogurt production. Acoustic implosions destabilize colloidal lipid complexes at low pH without inducing casein precipitation, allowing efficient de-oiling and mineral recovery.

feedMatrices.name: Enzymatically Hydrolyzed Oat Beverage Base (2.20% Lipid, 1.20% Protein, pH 6.80, 20–28°C)
feedMatrices.description: Plant-based emulsion containing natural oat oat-lipids stabilized by beta-glucan networks. Controlled acoustic pulses coalesce free oils to tailor calorie density and prevent off-flavor lipid oxidation during ambient aseptic cartoning.

acousticShockwaveStages.name: Dual Opposed 28 kHz Titanium Horn Transducers with Micro-Second Frequency Sweep
acousticShockwaveStages.acousticAttenuationCompliance: Full Soundproof Enclosure (< 78 dBA at 1 m)
acousticShockwaveStages.description: High-efficiency ultrasonic piezo-transducers with real-time resonance tracking. Induces violent cyclic compression and rarefaction cycles, nucleating micron-sized cavitation bubbles that collapse violently within 2.5 µs, stripping lipid membranes through localized hydraulic micro-jets.

acousticShockwaveStages.name: Focused Multi-Element 40 kHz Piezoelectric Ring Array (Gentle Emulsion Cleavage)
acousticShockwaveStages.acousticAttenuationCompliance: Standard Sound-Dampening Shroud (< 75 dBA at 1 m)
acousticShockwaveStages.description: High-frequency acoustic field tuned for selective lipid-phase coalescence. Creates steady acoustic radiation force (acoustophoresis) that drives emulsified fat droplets into antinodal acoustic pressure planes for rapid agglomeration without shear damage to native whey proteins.

acousticShockwaveStages.name: Hybrid 24 kHz Acoustic Horn + Hydrodynamic Venturi Constriction Slit
acousticShockwaveStages.acousticAttenuationCompliance: Heavy-Duty Acoustic Absorbing Enclosure (< 80 dBA at 1 m)
acousticShockwaveStages.description: Synergistic cavitation architecture coupling hydrodynamic Bernoulli pressure reduction (pressure drop from 30 bar to vapor pressure) with simultaneous 24 kHz acoustic shockwave excitation. Maximizes droplet collision frequency and emulsion demulsification rate.

acousticShockwaveStages.name: Unshielded High-Power Acoustic Resonator with Defective Enclosure (Severe Noise & Emitter Pit Erosion Hazard)
acousticShockwaveStages.acousticAttenuationCompliance: NON-COMPLIANT: Hazardous noise level (> 108 dBA), horn surface cavitation erosion spalling titanium particles into milk, and severe protein denaturation.
acousticShockwaveStages.description: Dangerous uncontrolled cavitation violating OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.95 and 3-A Sanitary Standards. Excessive acoustic intensity causes severe pitting of the titanium horn, releasing microscopic metal fragments into food streams and denaturing sensitive dairy immunoglobulins.

hydrocycloneSeparationStages.name: Triple-Stage Micro-Hydrocyclone Cluster with Ceramic Inflow Orifices
hydrocycloneSeparationStages.cleanInPlaceValidation: Full 3-A Sanitary 60-01 CIP Validated (Drainable Cone, Ra ≤ 0.38 µm)
hydrocycloneSeparationStages.description: Ultra-sanitary multi-cyclone manifold operating under high centrifugal field (3,200 × g). Continuously splits the acoustically destabilized milk stream into an ultra-low-fat skim underflow (<0.035% fat) and a concentrated cream overflow without moving mechanical disks.

hydrocycloneSeparationStages.name: Dual Counter-Current Sanitary Hydrocyclones with Pneumatic Core Valve
hydrocycloneSeparationStages.description: Two-stage separation cluster offering flexible cream concentration adjustment via automated pneumatic back-pressure regulation, suitable for fluctuating byproduct feeds.

hydrocycloneSeparationStages.name: Uncontrolled Single Gravity Clarifier Tank with Stagnant Flow (Microbial Spoilage & Rancid Oxidation Hazard)
hydrocycloneSeparationStages.cleanInPlaceValidation: NON-COMPLIANT: Severe dead leg stagnation, uncontrolled psychrotrophic bacterial growth, and high fat retention in effluent.
hydrocycloneSeparationStages.description: Defective separation system lacking centrifugal acceleration. Causes extended fluid residence time (>45 minutes), creating an optimal growth environment for Listeria monocytogenes and Pseudomonas psychrotrophs while leaving >0.6% residual fat in the product.

technicalStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Ultrasound and Hydrodynamic Homogenization Equipment for Dairy and Liquid Foods
technicalStandards.requirement: Mandates electropolished AISI 316L product contact surfaces (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), completely drainable acoustic flow cells, certified food-grade elastomers (FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600), and automated Clean-In-Place (CIP) spray validation without equipment disassembly.

technicalStandards.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels & High-Pressure Cavitation Flow Chambers
technicalStandards.requirement: Governs pressure vessel design, cyclic acoustic fatigue limits, nozzle reinforcement, and dual ASME UV-stamped safety pressure relief valves / rupture discs rated for maximum operating pressures up to 45 bar.

technicalStandards.title: Hygienic Equipment Design for Closed Liquid Food Processing Systems
technicalStandards.requirement: Requires the total elimination of dead spaces, sharp crevices, and screw threads in product contact areas, guaranteeing self-draining geometry and steam-in-place (SIP) sterility across transducer interfaces.

technicalStandards.title: Milk and Cream Products Standards of Identity & Non-Thermal Processing Requirements
technicalStandards.requirement: Establishes regulatory identity standards for skim milk (<0.5% fat), low-fat dairy streams, and concentrated cream fractions, mandating real-time fluid temperature verification to guarantee non-thermal integrity below pasteurization thresholds.

technicalStandards.title: Occupational Noise Exposure & Hearing Conservation in Acoustic Processing
technicalStandards.requirement: Regulates industrial sound pressure emissions from high-power ultrasonic transducers. Enforces sound-attenuating acoustic isolation enclosures ensuring operational ambient noise levels remain below the 8-hour time-weighted average (TWA) of 85 dBA.
